blocks.text: Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. For example, AI Overviews makes it easier to ask Google anything and get a helpful response. AI Mode allows users to ask more nuanced questions that might have previously taken multiple searches, using Gemini’s advanced reasoning, thinking, and multimodal capabilities.
